project.name: symfony/yaml
setup: git clone --depth 1 --branch v8.1.11 -c core.autocrlf=false https://github.com/symfony/yaml yaml
paratestSetup: remove the two <method>Doctrine\Deprecations\Deprecation::...</method> lines from phpunit.xml.dist
notes: The component ships without PHPUnit (the Symfony monorepo provides it), so PHPUnit and the PHPUnit bridge are added as dev dependencies.

phpunit.xml.dist names two Doctrine methods as deprecation triggers with ignoreUndefinedTriggers="true". Doctrine is not installed, so PHPUnit ignores them; ParaTest 7.29's workers assert that they exist and crash. The ParaTest copy drops the two lines, which leaves its effective configuration identical to PHPUnit's.
